title: The Pert Hen-Sparrow

full_text:
In the fragrant branches of a blossoming champaka tree lived a pair of tiny, devoted sparrows. The hen-sparrow laid a clutch of delicate, speckled eggs, brooding over them with maternal affection while her mate brought seeds and morning dew.

One sweltering noon, an arrogant, colossal rogue wild elephant named Mahadanti, crazed by rutting fluids, came crashing through the grove. Seeking to cool his burning forehead, the brute seized the branch containing the sparrows' nest and snapped it like a dry reed, trampling the fragile nest and smashing all the eggs upon the stones.

The hen-sparrow wept in unbearable grief over her broken children, while the elephant marched past with a scornful trumpet.

The cock-sparrow comforted her: 'Weep not, beloved. Intelligence allied with loyal friends will avenge our children.'

The sparrows flew to their loyal companions: a sharp-billed woodpecker, an agile buzzing fly, and a wise marsh frog.

The four small creatures devised a flawless stratagem.

First, the fly buzzed into the elephant's ears, singing a sweet, mesmerizing veena-like melody. Charmed by the lullaby, the giant closed his eyes in bliss.

The instant his eyes were shut tight, the woodpecker swooped from the bough and with his iron beak struck out both the elephant's eyes, blinding him completely!

Roaring in agony, the blinded colossus staggered through the forest, dying of parched thirst.

The marsh frog then hopped to the edge of a yawning, bottomless rocky ravine and began croaking loudly in chorus with his companions: 'CROAK! CROAK! CROAK!'

Believing the croaking came from a cool, deep lake, the blind elephant rushed forward and plummeted over the precipice, crashing upon the boulders below to his death!

The tiny sparrows sang in triumph, proving that no giant can oppress the humble with impunity.

Thus Vishnu Sharma taught:
"Let no colossus boast his bulk, his tusks, or mountain size;
For tiny creatures bound in love will make his kingdom fall;
The blind and broken tyrant lies beneath the open skies,
Defeated by the sparrows' wit that triumphed over all."
moral: A united alliance of the small and humble brings down the colossal oppressor who crushed their nest.
